desc:
🏃HUSS HUSS🏃BREAK ANKLES. CROSS THE FIELD. DON'T GET CAUGHT. 🔪

Sprint from safe zone to safe zone while the Hunters close in. Get caught and you join them! Runners win with 3 clean crossings in a row. Hunters win by catching every last Runner.

⚡ PERFECT DODGE at the last second to break a Hunter's ankles
🌊 HIT FLOWSTATE and leave your trail behind
🦸 BE THE HERO: cross alone to power up every Runner... or chicken out 🐔
💀 LAST ONE LEFT? You're the Deadman.
🩹 REVIVE teammates and master 5 abilities: Medic, Rescuer, Decoy, Tether & Special Delivery

🛒 200 COLLECTIBLES
• 25 knives • 23 flow trails • 14 dodge effects
• 7 dodge styles • 24 emotes • 100+ titles
💃 EMOTE SYNC with friends and dance in step
🏆 100 ACHIEVEMENTS that pay Bux & Tix
🎁 Daily rewards, daily & weekly challenges

Can you survive the Hunt?
👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
